message:
docs(policy): a test host's display wake and power keepalive are off too, not only its input

Codex finding-3 decision (codex_test_injection_finding.md): input OFF does not stop the stream-start wake
(SendInput +1/-1, SC_MONITORPOWER broadcast) nor HostPowerKeepalive's ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED / ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED.
Real-host tests block them with an explicit local-only OFF applied before the first effect, or a reviewed
record-only boundary; the launch's effective state is seen before connecting. Reviewed diff sha 20ca205a.
